San Diego Blood Bank is a nonprofit organization providing blood banking and biotherapy services to hospitals in Southern California. The Software Engineer I develops and maintains browser-based business applications across the full technology stack, including user interfaces, APIs, business logic, and data layers, while receiving mentorship and supporting other development and IT projects.
Healthcare
Non Profit
Health Care
Responsibilities
Develop, test, and maintain features across the full application stack, including user interface components, APls, business logic, and database components, under the direction of the Lead Software Engineer
Translate wireframes, mockups, and business requirements into responsive, accessible browser-based interfaces
Develop and maintain database schemas, queries, and data access code following the architecture established by the Lead Software Engineer
Implement data validation, error handling, and security controls within assigned features
Build and maintain integrations with internal systems and third-party services
Write clean, well-documented code following established team coding standards and version control workflow
Write and maintain automated tests for assigned features
Participate in code reviews, pair programming sessions, and team planning meetings
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve defects in assigned areas of the application; test fixes to ensure problems have been adequately resolved

Required
Associate's degree or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field/discipline from an accredited college or university, completion of a software development training program, or equivalent combination of education, training and/or experience
1-3 years of software development experience, or a strong portfolio of academic, personal, or training program projects
Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
Working knowledge of at least one server-side programming language (such as Python, C#, Java, or Node.js)
Basic knowledge of relational databases and SOL
Familiarity with Git-based version control
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to learn new technologies quickly
Effective verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work collaboratively within a team
Strong organizational and time management skills
Eagerness to learn, accept feedback, and grow within a small team
Preferred
Familiarity with a modern front-end framework (such as React, Vue, or Angular)
Benefits
Employees working 30 or more hours per week are eligible for employer sponsored health benefits (Medical, Dental, & Vision plans)
Earn up to 120 hours of paid vacation in your first year.
7 paid Holidays + 1 personal holiday provided annually.
40 hours of paid sick time provided annually.
403b retirement plan with 3% employer match starting on your first day.
Employee Assistance Program - Free for employees and their families
Service Awards and recognition.
